synopsis: Chapter 12 identifies AACE Recommended Practice 57R-09 as a method for integrated cost and schedule risk analysis using risk drivers [f9632]. The glossary reinforces that description and adds Monte Carlo simulation of a critical-path model as methodological detail [f16436]. A shorter glossary entry describes the practice simply as schedule risk analysis; this is narrower wording, not an explicit disagreement about its scope [f16330, f9632, f16436].

relations.note: Adds Monte Carlo simulation of a critical-path model to the chapter's integrated risk-analysis description.
Expands schedule risk analysis to integrated cost analysis, risk drivers, and Monte Carlo simulation.
Adds integrated cost analysis and risk drivers to the glossary's shorter description.
